verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships Copilot as a built-in assistant you can hand tasks to. First-party pages say you can start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks in-app, assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request, iterate on it via comments, and ask Copilot in natural language to open a pull request. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy (limits, supported task types, how progress is reported) and any independent or hands-on confirmation that delegation works from the mobile app.
